current_goal: Measure and save the strongest utility-constrained GU configuration attainable for each of six registered benchmarks, then use the oracle configs to derive and falsify a principled adaptive configuration policy.
do_not_redo: Do not attribute 20-epoch forgetting gains to adaptive GU.
Do not use scope12_no_gu20 as evidence for hard freezing alone.
Do not label all-endpoint equality as strict Pareto gain.
Do not treat Fisher trace coverage as an operator-norm trust-region certificate.
Do not claim matched forgetting from one equal-budget real/shuffled pair.
Do not claim online overhead from cross-queue timing.
Do not average unrelated endpoint metrics or hide seed-level failures.
Do not save model, checkpoint, optimizer, scheduler, trainer-state, or RNG payloads.
next_options: Oracle-envelope search using existing matrix priors followed by seed validation.
Single-method SimNPO search for cross-benchmark comparability.
Mechanism-first native-scope tangent Anchor-GU feasibility before any broad search.
open_loops: Define the per-benchmark utility-constrained forgetting objective and deterministic tie-breaker.
Mine the completed 175-job GU matrix and 59 matched baselines to choose method/config priors.
Run a bounded multi-fidelity oracle search on GPU0/1 without hard scope12 as the assumed utility mechanism.
Validate selected configs across seeds and save one immutable config plus evidence per benchmark.
Identify which observable pre-run or early-trajectory signals causally predict oracle config choices.
Design an adaptive policy that approximates the oracle choices without endpoint leakage.
uncertainty: The best method and config may differ across benchmark and seed.
Existing full-matrix GU results confound trainable scope, selected precision, and projection.
MUSE has multiple forgetting metrics requiring a preregistered multi-objective rule.
No repeated same-seed evaluator variance is available for deltas below 0.01.
Native-scope tangent Anchor-GU memory and spectral-residual feasibility are unknown.
Cross-benchmark adaptive signals and endpoint-free selection validity are unmeasured.
